title: Jingyang Ridge
description: Wu Song meets the white-browed tiger on Jingyang Ridge, painted in ink wash. Read the pounce, swipe and tail-sweep tells, dodge into a safe lane and punish the tiger while it recovers.
controls: Left / Right or A / D dodge · Space / J / click strike · touch buttons on phones · P / Esc pause · R restart

zh-CN.title: 景阳冈
zh-CN.description: 水墨风《水浒传》武松打虎。看清猛虎扑、掀、剪的起手，闪到安全的位置，趁它落空时连拳打虎。
zh-CN.controls: ← → 或 A / D 闪避 · 空格 / J / 点击 出拳 · 手机用屏幕按钮 · P / Esc 暂停 · R 重开
